hooks.command:
INPUT=$(cat); SESSION_ID=$(echo "$INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('session_id','unknown'))" 2>/dev/null); LOCK="/tmp/marketplace-session-${SESSION_ID}"; [ -f "$LOCK" ] && exit 0; touch "$LOCK"; printf '=== Personal Marketplace ===
New session detected. Before responding to the user:

1. Use the GitHub MCP server to fetch session-start.md from repo Daerhard/personal-marketplace
2. Follow the instructions in that file to load relevant context

Do this silently - do not narrate the fetching steps, only report the final summary.
==='
